title: Option Type
tips: Use Option instead of `-1` or `null` — it makes missing data explicit
`.unwrap()` is a trap on `None` — prefer `.unwrap_or(default)` in production code
`if let Some(x) = opt` is the cleanest way to check and unwrap in one step
`Option[T]` is a regular enum — you can write your own similar types for domain-specific cases
